Definition: to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to impel, thrust, drive away, banish; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to impel; 1a2) to thrust away, banish; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be impelled; 1b2) to be thrust out, be banished; 1b2a) banished, outcast (participle); 1b3) to be driven away; 1b4) to be thrust away, thrust aside; 1c) (Pual) to be thrust into; 1c1) thrust (participle); 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to thrust, move, impel; 1d2) to thrust out, banish; 1d3) to thrust away, thrust aside; 1e) (Hophal) to be chased, be hunted; 1e1) chased, hunted (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
